# Virtuous Styles by Q

> Natural hair & silk press based in Georgetown, Texas. Aquita “Q” Gaddis is a texture hair specialist: silk presses, natural hair care, Brazilian blowouts, cuts, color and sew-ins from her private studio in Georgetown. She listens before she touches a strand.

- Phone: (512) 770-3340
- Based in: Georgetown, TX
- Nearby areas: Georgetown, Round Rock, Hutto, Leander, Cedar Park, Pflugerville
- Google rating: 4.8 from 67 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/vsbq-and-its-a-vibe/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/vsbq-and-its-a-vibe/book.html

## Services
- Silk press: Shampoo, condition and a flat-iron finish that's sleek, shiny and still moves, on natural or relaxed hair. From $110.
- Natural hair & treatments: Healthy hair first: steam deep conditioning, twist-outs and a plan for growing it out, including the switch from relaxers.
- Brazilian blowout: Smoother, frizz-free hair, with every step and the aftercare explained before you leave the chair. From $250.
- Cuts & color: Precision dry cuts, pixies and shape-ups, root touch-ups, highlights and full color. From $75.
- Sets, updos & special days: Bouncy roller sets and polished styles for birthdays, photos, weddings and nights out. From $100.
- Kids' hair: Gentle, patient appointments for little ones, from first-ever hair days to sleek presses. From $45.

## About
Virtuous Styles by Q (“VSBQ” & It's A “Vibe” on Google) is Aquita Gaddis's private studio: Studio #22 inside 900 N Austin Ave, Suite 313, in Georgetown. One chair, a gold VSBQ sign, and a motto on the wall: Healthy Hair, Happy People. Her clients call her Q or Ms. Q. Some have been with her for nine years and brought their daughters along; one says Q inspired her daughter to become a beautician and a barber. Others found her after moving to the Austin area and needing a stylist they could trust. What they mention most: she listens, she's honest about the condition of your hair, she explains every step and the aftercare, and she cares about healthy hair, from silk presses with no chemicals to growing out a relaxer. And it always feels like catching up with an old friend.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Wednesday and Thursday 10 a.m. to 6:30 p.m., Friday 10 a.m. to 8 p.m., and Saturday 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Closed Sunday to Tuesday. Book online or call (512) 770-3340.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: Studio #22 inside 900 N Austin Ave, Suite 313, Georgetown, TX 78626.
- Q: How much does a silk press cost?
  A: A silk press on natural hair starts at $125, on relaxed hair at $110, and with a steam treatment and trim at $175. The full price list is on the Services page.
- Q: Do you work on natural hair?
  A: Yes, it's what Q loves. Silk presses on natural hair, steam deep conditioning, twist-outs, trims, and help moving from a relaxer to natural.
- Q: Do you need a deposit?
  A: New clients pay a deposit on some services when booking online. Please cancel 24 to 48 hours ahead to avoid a 30% cancellation fee.
- Q: Can Q come to me?
  A: Yes. Q offers mobile appointments in Austin ($100+ travel fee) and outside Austin ($150+). Book online or call to set it up.
